#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
using namespace std;

struct CF884F {
    static const int A = 26;
    static const int INF = 1e9;
    int n, N, S, T;
    struct Edge {
        int to, rev, cap, cost;
        Edge(int to, int rev, int cap, int cost) : to(to), rev(rev), cap(cap), cost(cost) {}
    };
    vector<vector<Edge>> g;
    vector<int> pot;
    vector<bool> vis;

    void addEdge(int v, int to, int cap, int cost) {
        int i = g[v].size(), j = g[to].size();
        g[v].push_back(Edge(to, j, cap, cost));
        g[to].push_back(Edge(v, i, 0, -cost));
    }

    int dfs(int v, int f) {
        if (v == T) return f;
        vis[v] = true;
        for (Edge &e : g[v]) {
            if (e.cap > 0 && !vis[e.to] && e.cost + pot[v] - pot[e.to] == 0) {
                int ret = dfs(e.to, min(f, e.cap));
                if (ret > 0) {
                    e.cap -= ret;
                    g[e.to][e.rev].cap += ret;
                    vis[v] = false;
                    return ret;
                }
            }
        }
        vis[v] = false;
        return 0;
    }

    int minCostFlow(int s, int t) {
        S = s; T = t;
        pot.assign(N, INF);
        pot[s] = 0;

        // Bellman-Ford for initial potentials
        for (int it = 0; it < N - 1; ++it) {
            bool upd = false;
            for (int v = 0; v < N; ++v) {
                if (pot[v] == INF) continue;
                for (const Edge &e : g[v]) {
                    if (e.cap > 0 && pot[e.to] > pot[v] + e.cost) {
                        pot[e.to] = pot[v] + e.cost;
                        upd = true;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!upd) break;
        }

        int total = 0;
        while (true) {
            vector<int> dist(N, INF);
            dist[s] = 0;
            priority_queue<pair<int,int>, vector<pair<int,int>>, greater<pair<int,int>>> pq;
            pq.push({0, s});
            while (!pq.empty()) {
                auto cur = pq.top(); pq.pop();
                int d = cur.first, v = cur.second;
                if (d != dist[v]) continue;
                for (const Edge &e : g[v]) {
                    if (e.cap <= 0) continue;
                    int nd = d + e.cost + pot[v] - pot[e.to];
                    if (dist[e.to] > nd) {
                        dist[e.to] = nd;
                        pq.push({nd, e.to});
                    }
                }
            }

            if (dist[t] == INF) break;

            for (int v = 0; v < N; ++v)
                if (dist[v] < INF) pot[v] += dist[v];

            vis.assign(N, false);
            while (true) {
                int f = dfs(s, INF);
                if (f == 0) break;
                total += f * (pot[t] - pot[s]);
            }
        }
        return total;
    }

    void run() {
        int original_n;
        cin >> original_n;
        n = original_n / 2;
        N = 1 + n + A + 1; // n + A + 2
        g.resize(N);
        string s;
        cin >> s;
        vector<int> b(2 * n);
        for (int i = 0; i < 2 * n; ++i) {
            cin >> b[i];
        }
        int source = 0, sink = N - 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            addEdge(source, 1 + i, 2, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            int j = 2 * n - 1 - i;
            int ai = s[i] - 'a';
            int aj = s[j] - 'a';
            for (int a = 0; a < A; ++a) {
                int val;
                if (a == ai && a == aj) val = max(b[i], b[j]);
                else if (a == ai) val = b[i];
                else if (a == aj) val = b[j];
                else val = 0;
                addEdge(1 + i, 1 + n + a, 1, -val);
            }
        }
        vector<int> cnt(A, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < 2 * n; ++i) cnt[s[i] - 'a']++;
        for (int a = 0; a < A; ++a) {
            addEdge(1 + n + a, sink, cnt[a], 0);
        }
        cout << -minCostFlow(source, sink) << endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    CF884F solver;
    solver.run();
    return 0;
}
